title: Typed put get delete list verbs with the metadata field pattern realise the Workers KV binding shape behind the facade
description: The facade exposes typed named domain verbs put(key, value, {ttl?, metadata?}), get(key), getWithMetadata(key), delete(key) and list({prefix?, limit?, cursor?}) whose contracts map directly onto the Cloudflare Workers KV binding shape per https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/api/. put writes with expirationTtl (per the elicited default TTL from ADR-3202) and metadata (per the elicited default metadata field pattern; ship default {v: number}); get returns null on miss; getWithMetadata returns {value, metadata}; delete is idempotent; list paginates keys with metadata shape intact. Metadata is a JSON-serialisable object; the facade never rewrites it before storage.
rationale: Ratified in the Cloudflare round 6 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.1). Ships as v1.0.0 of platform-cloudflare-kv.
